page.layout: One page of text, full width. Title "BENIGNO LECTORI." centred above one paragraph of text. Below it, a line "Soli DEO Gloria." between two rules. Ornamental borders at top and bottom, not text. No margin notes.

main_text.l: IRENICI hujus major pars αὐτοχεδιασὶ delineata, &

l.i: festinantibus operis, ad prælum ilicò rapta est. Unde factum, ut postea rele-
genti occurrerint nonnulla quæ clarioris explicationis indigere existimavi.
Quocirca quæ impræsentiarum inserenda vel etiam mutanda videbantur, ea
satius duxi in istis pagellis tibi candidè exhibere, quam mea mihi animad-

main_text.l: versa παραφάσματα aliis vel sequenda vel reprehendenda relinquere.

l.i: Te interea, benigne Lector, amanter rogo, ut hanc ingenui animi opellam

main_text.l: boni consulas. Nihil enim in toto hoc negotio ago καθ' ἑτερομέρησιν:
sed veritati & paci, coram DEO, studiosè deservio: & quæ vera judico, ea sine fuco, χωρὶς οἰασδήποτε
προσαπαθείας ἢ ἀντιπαθείας, enuncio. Divina igitur misericordia fiducia in spem bonam optati successus

page.notes: The opening "I" is a large initial, read as I plus "RENICI". The word after "delineata," is printed as "festinantibus" but the scan is smudged; the reading is doubtful. The Greek words, especially "αὐτοχεδιασὶ", "καθ' ἑτερομέρησιν" and "προσαπαθείας", may differ slightly from the print. The top and bottom ornamental borders are decorative and not transcribed.
